name: Stage Sim: rehearsal transport
description: The Stage Sim window plays the editor's show: Enter plays and pauses it (also after clicking a button), Home goes to the start. The audio-sync delay shows in the editor's show transport and in the Stage Sim, is not saved, and ends when the Stage Sim window closes.

steps.label: The Stage Sim window mirrors the show
Enter in the Stage Sim plays the editor's show
After a mouse click on a button, Enter still plays the show (it does not press the button)
Home goes back to the start

steps.js: (() => { const box = document.querySelector('[data-stage-audio-sync-panel] input[type=checkbox]'); if (!box.checked) box.click(); const r = document.querySelector('[data-stage-audio-sync-panel] input[type=range]'); r.value = '120'; r.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

steps.label: A 120 ms audio-sync delay shows in the editor and in the Stage Sim, and is not saved
Closing the Stage Sim ends the delay
